This standing ab workout with weights for over 50 is designed to help you strengthen your core, improve balance, and support everyday movement—without getting down on the floor. All you need is one dumbbell (or a large water bottle).
Perfect for beginners, seniors, and anyone looking for a safe and effective core workout, this routine uses light weights and controlled movements to help you feel stronger, more supported, and more confident in your body.
What You’ll Get:
Standing ab exercises using light weights (one dumbbell)
No floor work – easy on the joints
